product_overview: The Sustainable Eco-Friendly Digital Nomads Directory is a web platform designed to catalogue and promote eco-conscious venues and services for remote workers and digital nomads. It consolidates vetted, sustainability-focused listings enriched with rich metadata, editorial content, and advanced search features enabling users to discover sustainable co-working spaces, eco-friendly accommodations, and related services with ease.
core_goals: Enable users to discover and compare environmentally responsible venues and services efficiently through a rich, searchable catalog.
Provide venue owners and content editors with tools to manage, update, and moderate listings and content securely.
Maintain high data quality and platform governance through admin moderation tools and analytics.
Support user engagement via features like reviews, ratings, favorites, and eco-friendly editorial content to encourage community building.
Ensure excellent performance, SEO, accessibility, and maintainability through a modern tech stack and best practices.
key_features: Listings Catalog: Browse and search sustainable venues with rich metadata such as amenities, eco-tags, location, images, and sustainability scores.
Advanced Search and Geo-Filtering: Multi-criteria filtering including geo-radius, category, and eco-tags with map integration using Leaflet.js.
Authentication and Role-Based Access Control: Secure user accounts with roles including admin, venue owner, editor, and standard user.
Admin Dashboard and Moderation Tools: Analytics, bulk operations, flagging, and content moderation features for managing platform quality.
Content Management via Sanity CMS: Editorial CMS allowing non-technical users to update listings, city pages, and blog content.
Image Handling and Performance Optimization: Safe rendering using Sanity image pipeline, CDN optimizations, and Next.js image handling with accessibility support.
Review and Rating System: Allow authenticated users to submit listings reviews with moderation workflows and analytics.
Eco-Friendly Blog: Editorial content including guides, city spotlights, and sustainability tips to drive SEO and community engagement.
Listing Detail Pages: Rich venue info including images carousel, amenities, sustainability metrics, maps, related listings, and SEO metadata.
user_flow_summary: Discovery Flow: User searches and filters listings by location and eco-tags, views listing details, checks sustainability scores and images, and saves favorites.
Listing Management Flow: Venue owners authenticate, create or edit their listings through Sanity CMS, then publish updates that reflect immediately or via webhook-triggered revalidation.
Moderation Flow: Admins log in to access dashboard, review flagged content or user reports, perform bulk operations, and update moderation status on listings or reviews.
Community Interaction Flow: Authenticated users submit reviews and ratings on listings, browse editorial blog content, and engage with the community.

Search and Map Interaction Flow: Users interact with an integrated map UI that dynamically fetches and debounces search results, providing a spatial browsing experience with accessible, responsive controls.
validation_criteria: Listing detail pages render correctly with all information: images, maps centered at correct coordinates, sustainability metrics, and related listings slider.
SEO compliance with correct meta tags, canonical URLs, structured data, and accessibility standards including ARIA roles and keyboard support.
Robust unit tests covering core UI components like ListingCard, ListingGallery, and admin listing management features.
End-to-end tests validating user workflows such as loading listings, interacting with galleries and maps, authentication, and review submissions.
API stability with secure role-based access control ensuring proper authorization for admin and owner workflows.
Sanity CMS integration correctly manages content types, supports draft previews for authenticated editors, and enforces unique slug validation per city.
Performance benchmarks met for image loading, map interactions (including debounced server calls), and page load times with proper caching and ISR revalidation.
Reliable webhook-triggered content invalidation on publishing or updating listings to minimize stale content.
Proper environment variable validation during setup and continuous integration to avoid configuration errors.
Comprehensive documentation and developer guides for setup, testing, deployment, and schema updates.
Authentication & session security: HTTP-only, secure cookies with SameSite, CSRF protection, and role checks enforced on all API routes (unit/integration tests included).
Stripe webhooks: signature verification, idempotency keys for write operations, and strict separation of test vs production credentials.
Abuse prevention: rate limiting and spam detection on review submissions and moderation endpoints.
Auditability: tamper-evident audit logs for admin and moderator actions with actor, timestamp, resource, and outcome.
Privacy & compliance: PII minimization, documented retention/deletion policies, and a basic DSR response workflow.
